main_text.p: culumq; instar concreti luti grauant. Hac Ga-lenus. præstanë[?] magnam in cibo-

De alica velim in hac submonitione le-gratiam Elorem[?] in transcursu quasi meminisse eam nunc frugis genus esse, nunc ex fruge factam fari-obtinen-tes: con-nam, indeq; pulticulam vel forbitionem. Pro tra si perfruge accipitur à Plin. l.18.c.7. vbi de frumen-frixerinttis per tempora satis inquit, aliqui verna, myli-Vera sen-um, panicum, lentem, cicer, alicam appel-tentia delant.alica.
Et Celsus l.2.c.17. inter frumenta expresse numerat alicam. Cap. item 19. inquit: Boni Alicasucci sunt triticum, Siligo, Zea, Alica, Amy-frumen-tum.lum: vt ita quartum farris genus Columella.

sc. halicastrum si: alica. Ab eodem quoque Plinio alica pro pulte accipitur, sicut & ab aliis, in sanitatis quidem statu locum habens, sed diuersis locis diuersimode præparata, vt patet ex Plin. l.18. c.11. vbi varia eius genera conficiendique modos ponit, & ex Zea fieri tradit, &c. Alicapultegenus.

De Secali hoc sub huius submonitionis sinem adiiciendum existimo, quod latinis quibusdam vt Plinio fuerit notum, à gracorum vero nullo proditum. Rei scriptores rufticæ Romani, Cato, Varro, Columella & Palladius nullam fecerunt de ea mentionem, vel quia vsum eius ingratissimum putarunt, saque Subalpinis familiarem, aut quia non Secale.dignam

page.notes: The right-margin notes are reconstructed from the scan and are placed at approximate points beside their lines. The first word of the page's opening line and "Elorem" (possibly Florem) are doubtful. The page is dense with small, faded type, and several words near the ends of lines are uncertain. The "M 4" signature mark and the catchword "dignam" are at the foot.
